20261122-chemistry-e4-1.steps.0.prompt: [Advanced change of state] Dem put water inside beaker and heat am until e start to boil hard. Even if dem increase di flame and continue to heat am, di thermometer reading no go up pass 100℃ anymore. Why?

20261122-chemistry-e4-2.material: Which pair correctly match di change of state process of clear 'dew' wey dey form for grass leaf for early morning and white 'frost' wey dey form for window or roof for night for late autumn?
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.thinking.0: Which pair correctly match di change
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.prompt: Which pair correctly match di change of state process of clear 'dew' wey dey form for grass leaf for early morning and white 'frost' wey dey form for window or roof for night for late autumn?
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.explain: Dew na di water vapor for air wey condense (liquefy) for di grass leaf surface wey cool down for night, and frost na wen water vapor turn ice crystals directly without passing through liquid for temperature below zero (deposition).
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.hint.0: Dew na liquid water drops (water vapor → liquid).
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.hint.1: Frost na ice crystals wey form for temperature below zero (water vapor → solid).
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.o.o0: Dew: water vapor turn liquid water drops (condensation) / Frost: water vapor turn ice crystals straight (deposition)
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.o.o1: Dew: ice melt (melting) / Frost: water boil (vaporization)
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.o.o2: Both dew and frost na water wey evaporate turn vapor
20261122-chemistry-e4-2.s.s1.o.o3: Dew: spring water wey comot from ground / Frost: snow wey fall from sky
